description: Canonical portfolio root nodes. These four portfolios are the anchor points for orphan detection: any graph node that cannot be traced to one of these portfolio roots via a qualifying path is flagged is_orphan: true by the Sprint 2 orphan detector.

portfolios.name: Foundational
portfolios.description: IT infrastructure, platform services, and architectural building blocks that underpin all value streams. Includes compute, network, data platforms, and security capabilities.

portfolios.name: Manufacturing and Delivery
portfolios.description: Products and capabilities that support the internal manufacture and delivery pipeline: CI/CD, build tooling, release orchestration, and deployment automation.

portfolios.name: Workforce
portfolios.description: The workforce and the internal digital products it consumes. This evolves the legacy For Employees label to include employees, contractors, AI coworkers, robots, non-human identities, and any other accountable actor that performs or approves work. Products include productivity tools, ITSM, HR systems, internal portals, and the AI coworker services/offers the workforce runs on. Canonical key stays `for_employees`.
portfolios.it4it_reference: DPPM Provided Internally / legacy IT4IT §6.3 For Employees Portfolio

portfolios.name: Goods and Services for Sale
portfolios.description: Revenue-generating goods and services offered to external consumers. Includes physical goods, digital products, service offers, experiences, access products, and other commercially available market offerings.
portfolios.it4it_reference: IT4IT §6.4 Products and Services Sold Portfolio (source terminology)
